notes.text: Don't retry the refresh_token grant as is. Keyline rotates refresh tokens and revokes the whole token family when a used one is sent again. A timeout can hit after the server already rotated, so a plain retry signs every device out (vendor doc §10.2).
notes.author: codex

notes.text: A refresh can be retried safely with one Idempotency-Key reused across all attempts: Keyline replays the first response for 60 s without reuse detection (vendor doc §11). transport.post(path, body, { idempotencyKey }) already sends it.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: SessionGuard retries an API call once after a 401. A refresh that fails with 400 invalid_grant is never retried: the family is gone, so sign the user out.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: post() rejects with TransportError (code ETIMEDOUT or ECONNRESET) only when no HTTP response arrived. Pass options.idempotencyKey to send the Idempotency-Key header.
notes.author: claude-code
